questions.en: Which district of Bihar has the highest percentage of its geographical area covered under forest as per the India State of Forest Report (ISFR) 2021?(
questions.hi: भारत वन स्थिति रिपोर्ट (ISFR) 2021 के अनुसार, बिहार के किस जिले में उसके भौगोलिक क्षेत्रफल का सर्वाधिक प्रतिशत वनाच्छादित है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Kaimur district leads Bihar with 31.56% of its area under forest cover (1,051.56 sq km), followed by Jamui (21.34%) and Nawada (20.72%). West Champaran has the largest absolute forest area (903.34 sq km).
questions.tip: Highest Forest Percentage = Kaimur (31.56%); Highest Absolute Forest Area = Kaimur (1,051 sq km); Lowest forest = Sheikhpura.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Kaimur district leads Bihar with 31.56% of its area under forest cover (1,051.56 sq किमी), followed by Jamui (21.34%) and Nawada (20.72%). पश्चिम Champaran has the largest absolute forest area (903.34 sq किमी).
questions.tip_hi: Highest Forest प्रतिशत = Kaimur (31.56%); Highest Absolute Forest Area = Kaimur (1,051 sq किमी); Lowest forest = Sheikhpura.

questions.en: A Proclamation of President's Rule under Article 356 in a State must be approved by resolutions of both Houses of Parliament within what time limit?
questions.hi: किसी राज्य में अनुच्छेद 356 के तहत राष्ट्रपति शासन की उद्घोषणा को संसद के दोनों सदनों द्वारा कितने समय के भीतर अनुमोदित किया जाना चाहिए?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Article 356(3) mandates that a proclamation of President's Rule ceases to operate at the expiration of 2 months unless approved by resolutions of both Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha by simple majority. National Emergency (Art. 352) requires approval within 1 month.
questions.tip: Approval deadline: National Emergency (Art. 352) = 1 month; President's Rule (Art. 356) = 2 months; Financial Emergency (Art. 360) = 2 months.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: अनुच्छेद 356(3) mandates that a proclamation of राष्ट्रपति's Rule ceases to operate at the expiration of 2 माह unless approved by resolutions of both लोकसभा and राज्यसभा by simple majority. National Emergency (Art. 352) requires approval within 1 माह.
questions.tip_hi: Approval deadline: National Emergency (Art. 352) = 1 माह; राष्ट्रपति's Rule (Art. 356) = 2 माह; Financial Emergency (Art. 360) = 2 माह.

questions.en: A shopkeeper marks his goods at 20% above the cost price and allows a discount of 10% for cash payment. What is his net profit percentage?
questions.hi: एक दुकानदार अपनी वस्तुओं पर क्रय मूल्य से 20% अधिक मूल्य अंकित करता है और नकद भुगतान पर 10% की छूट देता है। उसका शुद्ध लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Let CP = 100. Marked Price = 120. Discount = 10% of 120 = 12. Selling Price = 120 - 12 = 108. Profit % = 108 - 100 = 8%.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Let CP = 100. Marked Price = 120. Discount = 10% of 120 = 12. Selling Price = 120 - 12 = 108. Profit % = 108 - 100 = 8%.

questions.en: What is the sum of the interior angles of a regular convex octagon (polygon with 8 sides)?(
questions.hi: एक सम अष्टभुज (8 भुजाओं वाले बहुभुज) के सभी अंतःकोणों का योग क्या होगा?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sum of interior angles of an n-sided polygon = (n - 2) * 180°. For an octagon (n = 8): Sum = (8 - 2) * 180° = 6 * 180° = 1,080°.
questions.tip: Formula: (n - 2) * 180°. For 8 sides: 6 * 180° = 1,080°. Each interior angle = 1080/8 = 135°.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Sum of interior angles of an n-sided polygon = (n - 2) * 180°. For an octagon (n = 8): Sum = (8 - 2) * 180° = 6 * 180° = 1,080°.

questions.en: What are the real roots of the quadratic algebraic equation: x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0?
questions.hi: द्विघात समीकरण x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0 के वास्तविक मूल क्या हैं?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Factoring the quadratic: x^2 - 3x - 4x + 12 = 0 => x(x - 3) - 4(x - 3) = 0 => (x - 3)(x - 4) = 0. Therefore, x = 3 or x = 4.
questions.tip: Sum of roots = -(-7)/1 = 7; Product of roots = 12/1 = 12 => roots are 3 and 4.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Factoring the quadratic: x^2 - 3x - 4x + 12 = 0 => x(x - 3) - 4(x - 3) = 0 => (x - 3)(x - 4) = 0. Therefore, x = 3 or x = 4.
questions.tip_hi: Sum of roots = -(-7)/1 = 7; Product of roots = 12/1 = 12 => roots are 3 and 4.

questions.en: The HCF and LCM of two numbers are 11 and 693 respectively. If one of the numbers is 77, what is the other number?(
questions.hi: दो संख्याओं का म०स० (HCF) 11 और ल०स० (LCM) 693 है। यदि उनमें से एक संख्या 77 है, तो दूसरी संख्या क्या है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Product of two numbers = HCF * LCM. Other number = (HCF * LCM) / First number = (11 * 693) / 77 = 693 / 7 = 99.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Product of two numbers = HCF * LCM. Other number = (HCF * LCM) / First number = (11 * 693) / 77 = 693 / 7 = 99.

questions.en: A train 300 metres long crosses a railway platform 200 metres long in 25 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?
questions.hi: 300 मीटर लंबी एक रेलगाड़ी 200 मीटर लंबे रेलवे प्लेटफॉर्म को 25 सेकंड में पार करती है। रेलगाड़ी की गति किमी/घंटा में क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Total distance = Length of train + Length of platform = 300 + 200 = 500 m. Speed in m/s = 500 / 25 = 20 m/s. Speed in km/h = 20 * (18/5) = 72 km/h.
questions.tip: Total distance = 500 m. Speed = 500/25 = 20 m/s * (18/5) = 72 km/h.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Total distance = Length of train + Length of platform = 300 + 200 = 500 m. Speed in m/s = 500 / 25 = 20 m/s. Speed in किमी/h = 20 * (18/5) = 72 किमी/h.
questions.tip_hi: Total distance = 500 m. Speed = 500/25 = 20 m/s * (18/5) = 72 किमी/h.

questions.en: What are the primary hydrocarbon chemical components compressed under pressure inside domestic Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) cylinders?(
questions.hi: घरेलू एलपीजी (LPG) सिलेंडरों में दबाव में संपीड़ित मुख्य हाइड्रोकार्बन घटक कौन-से होते हैं?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Domestic LPG consists primarily of n-butane and isobutane (~60%) along with propane (~40%). A minute quantity of ethyl mercaptan (ethanethiol, C2H5SH) is added as a foul-smelling stenching agent to detect gas leaks.
questions.tip: LPG = Butane + Propane; Odorant for leak detection = Ethyl Mercaptan.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Domestic एलपीजी (द्रवीभूत पेट्रोलियम गैस) consists primarily of n-ब्यूटेन and isobutane (~60%) along with प्रोपेन (~40%). A मिनट quantity of ethyl mercaptan (ethanethiol, C2H5SH) is added as a foul-smelling stenching agent to detect gas leaks.
questions.tip_hi: एलपीजी (द्रवीभूत पेट्रोलियम गैस) = ब्यूटेन + प्रोपेन; Odorant for leak detection = Ethyl Mercaptan.

questions.en: Article 50 of the Constitution of India, contained in Part IV (Directive Principles of State Policy), directs the State to(
questions.hi: भारतीय संविधान के भाग IV (राज्य के नीति निदेशक तत्व) में निहित अनुच्छेद 50 राज्य को क्या निर्देश देता है?)
options: Separate the Judiciary from the Executive in the public services of the State
Organize village panchayats as units of self-government
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: Separate the Judiciary from the Executive in the public services of the State
questions.explanation: Article 50 obligates the State to take steps to separate the judiciary from the executive in public services. Article 40 deals with village panchayats, and Article 51 deals with international peace.
questions.tip: Article 50 = Separation of Judiciary from Executive; Article 40 = Panchayats; Article 44 = Uniform Civil Code.

Organize village panchayats as units of self-government

questions.en: Which gas in the stratosphere absorbs harmful ultraviolet (UV-B) radiations from the Sun, shielding life on Earth from cellular mutations and skin cancer?(
questions.hi: समताप मंडल में कौन-सी गैस सूर्य से आने वाली हानिकारक पराबैंगनी (UV-B) विकिरणों को अवशोषित करती है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The ozone layer in the stratosphere (15 to 35 km altitude) photolytically dissociates upon absorbing high-energy UV-B rays (O3 + UV -> O2 + O), preventing dangerous ionizing radiation from penetrating the troposphere.
questions.tip: UV-absorbing stratospheric gas = Ozone (O3); Measured in Dobson Units (DU).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The ozone layer in the stratosphere (15 to 35 किमी altitude) photolytically dissociates upon absorbing high-energy UV-B rays (O3 + UV -> O2 + O), preventing dangerous ionizing radiation from penetrating the troposphere.
questions.tip_hi: UV-absorbing stratospheric gas = Ozone (O3); Measured in Dobson Units (DU).

questions.en: A student walks from his home to school at a speed of 4 km/h and arrives 15 minutes late. If he walks at 6 km/h, he arrives exactly on time. What is the distance between his home and school?
questions.hi: एक छात्र अपने घर से 4 किमी/घंटा की गति से चलकर 15 मिनट देरी से विद्यालय पहुँचता है। यदि वह 6 किमी/घंटा की गति से चले तो ठीक समय पर पहुँचता है। उसके घर और विद्यालय के बीच की दूरी क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Time difference = 15 minutes = 15/60 = 1/4 hour. Distance = (S1 * S2) / (S2 - S1) * Time difference = (4 * 6) / (6 - 4) * (1/4) = 24 / 2 * 1/4 = 12 * 1/4 = 3 km.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Time difference = 15 मिनट = 15/60 = 1/4 घंटे. Distance = (S1 * S2) / (S2 - S1) * Time difference = (4 * 6) / (6 - 4) * (1/4) = 24 / 2 * 1/4 = 12 * 1/4 = 3 किमी.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 2.0 - TGT Social Science & Maths
questions.en: What is the length of the diagonal of a rectangle whose length is 12 cm and breadth is 5 cm?
questions.hi: एक आयत के विकर्ण की लंबाई क्या होगी जिसकी लंबाई 12 सेमी और चौड़ाई 5 सेमी है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras theorem, Diagonal = √(Length^2 + Breadth^2) = √(12^2 + 5^2) = √(144 + 25) = √169 = 13 cm.
questions.tip: Standard Pythagorean triplet: (5, 12, 13) => Diagonal = 13 cm.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: By Pythagoras theorem, Diagonal = √(Length^2 + Breadth^2) = √(12^2 + 5^2) = √(144 + 25) = √169 = 13 सेमी.
questions.tip_hi: Standard Pythagorean triplet: (5, 12, 13) => Diagonal = 13 सेमी.

questions.en: Two inlet pipes A and B can fill a tank in 15 hours and 20 hours respectively, while an outlet pipe C can empty the full tank in 25 hours. If all three pipes are opened together, in how many hours will the empty tank be filled?
questions.hi: दो नल A और B किसी टंकी को क्रमशः 15 घंटे और 20 घंटे में भर सकते हैं, जबकि एक निकासी नल C पूरी भरी टंकी को 25 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि तीनों नलों को एक साथ खोल दिया जाए, तो खाली टंकी कितने घंटे में भर जाएगी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: LCM of 15, 20, 25 = 300 units capacity. Efficiency of A = +20, B = +15, C = -12 units/hr. Net inflow = 20 + 15 - 12 = 23 units/hr. Time required = 300 / 23 hours = 13.04 hours.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: LCM of 15, 20, 25 = 300 units capacity. Efficiency of A = +20, B = +15, C = -12 units/hr. Net inflow = 20 + 15 - 12 = 23 units/hr. Time required = 300 / 23 घंटे = 13.04 घंटे.

questions.en: For any geometric circle, what is the universal ratio of its circumference to its diameter?
questions.hi: किसी भी ज्यामितीय वृत्त के लिए, उसकी परिधि और उसके व्यास का सार्वभौमिक अनुपात क्या होता है?
options: A constant irrational number π (approx. 22/7 or 3.14159)
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: A constant irrational number π (approx. 22/7 or 3.14159)
questions.explanation: By definition, π = Circumference / Diameter (C / 2r). It is a transcendental irrational mathematical constant whose exact value cannot be expressed as a finite fraction.
questions.tip: Ratio of Circumference to Diameter = π (Pi); π is an irrational number.

उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक

questions.en: What is the focal length and optical power of an ordinary flat plane mirror?(
questions.hi: एक साधारण समतल दर्पण की फोकस दूरी और प्रकाशिक शक्ति (Power) क्या होती है?)
options: Focal length is zero; Power is infinite
Focal length is infinite (∞); Power is zero (0 D)
Focal length is 1 metre; Power is 1 Dioptre
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: Focal length is infinite (∞); Power is zero (0 D)
questions.explanation: A plane mirror has no curvature (radius of curvature R = ∞), so its focal length f = R/2 = ∞. Optical power P = 1/f = 1/∞ = 0 Dioptres.
questions.tip: Plane mirror: Focal length = Infinite (∞); Power = 0 D; Magnification = +1.

questions.tip_hi: समतल दर्पण: Focal length = Infinite (∞); Power = 0 D; Magnification = +1.

With black flags and slogans only at the station
More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: With a complete citywide hartal and deserted streets (पूर्ण हड़ताल और वीरान सड़कें)
questions.explanation: On 22-23 December 1921, Patna observed a historic and total hartal against the Prince of Wales' visit called by the Congress. Markets and schools closed, and streets were completely deserted, delivering a stinging boycott to the colonial administration.
questions.tip: Prince of Wales visit to Patna (22 Dec 1921) = Met with total hartal and deserted streets.

questions.en: 'Operation Kaveri' was a high-risk humanitarian military rescue operation conducted by India in April 2023 to evacuate Indian citizens from which conflict-ridden nation?
questions.hi: 'ऑपरेशन कावेरी' अप्रैल 2023 में किस युद्धग्रस्त देश से भारतीय नागरिकों को सुरक्षित निकालने के लिए भारत द्वारा चलाया गया राहत अभियान था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Operation Kaveri evacuated over 3,800 Indian citizens stranded in Sudan during violent armed clashes between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), using IAF C-130J aircraft and INS Sumedha from Port Sudan.
questions.tip: Operation Kaveri = Sudan (2023); Operation Ajay = Israel-Gaza (2023); Operation Ganga = Ukraine (2022).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Operation Kaveri evacuated over 3,800 Indian citizens stranded in Sudan के दौरान violent armed clashes between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF), using IAF C-130J aircraft and INS Sumedha from Port Sudan.
questions.tip_hi: Operation Kaveri = Sudan (2023); Operation Ajay = Israel-Gaza (2023); Operation गंगा नदी = Ukraine (2022).

questions.en: The cost of 5 bats and 18 balls is ₹6,500 and the cost of 2 bats and 20 balls is ₹4,200. What are the costs of one bat and one ball respectively?
questions.hi: 5 बल्लों और 18 गेंदों की कीमत ₹6,500 है तथा 2 बल्लों और 20 गेंदों की कीमत ₹4,200 है। एक बल्ला और एक गेंद की कीमतें हैं, क्रमशः
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Solving the system 5x + 18y = 6500 and 2x + 20y = 4200 (x + 10y = 2100): substituting x = 2100 - 10y gives y = ₹125 and x = ₹850. Since ₹850 and ₹125 are not among (A), (B), or (C), Option (E) is correct.
questions.tip: Always solve linear systems directly: test the derived solution against choices before checking (E).

questions.en: The lengths of two sides of a triangle are 8 cm and 9 cm, and its area is 12√5 cm². What is the length of the third side?
questions.hi: किसी त्रिभुज की दो भुजाओं की लम्बाई 8 से० मी० और 9 से० मी० है तथा इसका क्षेत्रफल 12√5 से० मी०² है। तीसरी भुजा की लम्बाई क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.answer_text: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Area = (1/2)*8*9*sin C = 36 sin C = 12√5 -> sin C = √5/3. Thus cos C = ±2/3. By the Law of Cosines, c² = 8² + 9² - 2*8*9*(±2/3), yielding c = 7 cm or c = √241 cm. Since two values are valid, Option (D) is the answer.
questions.tip: When the sine of an angle is determined, both acute and obtuse angles yield valid triangles, giving two distinct third sides.

questions.en: There are 50 numbers. Each number is subtracted from 53, and the mean of the numbers so obtained is found to be -3.5. The mean of the given numbers is
questions.hi: 50 संख्याएँ दी हुई हैं। प्रत्येक संख्या को 53 से घटाया गया और इस तरह प्राप्त संख्याओं का माध्य -3.5 पाया गया। दी गई संख्याओं का माध्य है
options: More than one of the above
questions.tip: Linear property of arithmetic mean: E[a - X] = a - E[X]. Rearrange directly to find E[X] = a - mean.
